name: Hyman Cannabis Live Resin Disposable Stylus | Goosebumps
description:
Introducing HYMAN’s 2G Live Resin Stylus.

More flavor. More sessions. Same smooth experience. The HYMAN 2G Live Resin Stylus is crafted with live resin to preserve the plant’s natural terpene profile for brighter taste and well-balanced effects that last.

Featuring dual airflow for smooth, consistent draws and instant activation for effortless use, this stylus is built for convenience without cutting corners. A USB-C rechargeable, long-lasting battery powers you through the full 2 grams, while the eco-friendly design helps reduce waste.

Available in 5 carefully curated flavors, the 2G Stylus is made for those who want extended enjoyment with the same clean, terp-rich quality.

Goosebumps

Mood: Uplifting, Euphoria

Flavor & Aroma: Sweet, Candy
